$comment: HAND-AUTHORED — this file is NOT generated, unlike _consult-index.json.
A synonym lexicon for knowledge/_consult.py. The index is full of the KB's OWN vocabulary
(amber, gap, weight, CVD, catalog, dataviz, target-size...); people asking questions use
their own words (ochre, padding, bold, colour-blind, storybook, chart...). This file maps
the query word to the KB's canonical word so the search still finds the record.
MAINTENANCE MODEL — GROW ON MISS. This list is seeded (~30 entries), not exhaustive by
design. When a real query returns nothing useful because the asker's word doesn't match
the KB's word, add ONE line here mapping asker-word -> KB-word and move on. Curation is
part of the job (reviews/CONSOLIDATION-AUDIT-2026-07-18.html §3, Part 2) — do not try to
pre-populate every synonym anyone might ever use; that is a rewrite of the dictionary.
A synonym can also point at a concept rather than a single word — e.g. a hue name maps to
the general 'colour' term, so a question about one specific colour still finds the general
colour-governance rules (VD-1 / SC 1.4.1) alongside the colour-specific ruling.
Format: lowercase key -> lowercase value. Keys and values may be single words or short
phrases; phrase keys are matched against the raw query text, not per-token.
